scope: New visualization diagnostic of the exact final network checkpoints; not a training experiment, network trajectory prefix, or new superiority claim.
freeze: Before new diagnostic outcomes are inspected
component: Unit 5 alone; no transmission lines. Copy added[:2] and action[8:10] from each recorded network root.
initialization: Supplied physical voltage and inductor current, inverted by each existing model adapter. No observer or reference storage coordinates supplied to predictors.
native: predictors.make(native, staged_source); worker_three.native_path using maintained CompositionalPHAST and instrumented native_step
author: predictors.make(author, author_source); pinned CompositePHDAE RK4 followed by existing correction.run_path algebraic correction, differential dimension 2
reference: phast.benchmarks.microgrid_decision.rollout_candidates: independent DOP853, checked against refined RK45
qualification: Reuse network protocol reference refinement, physical roundtrip, midpoint and algebraic residual gates. Verify final checkpoint SHA-256 and frozen parameter fingerprint.
metrics: Voltage and inductor-current RMSE over steps 1..200. Failures retained with null display series and no substituted score.
selection: All 80 network cases in original order. No largest-gap selection or replacement; default follows current network scenario.
pilot: Fit 1 / episode 0 for both methods and reference, separate from production. Qualification failure blocks production.
failure_policy: Preserve attempts, inputs, raw traces and error records. No tuning, retraining or silent fallbacks. Network and original learning archives remain untouched.
